translated_title: US Hands Over 10 Individuals Sought by Mexico for Various Serious Crimes and Organized Crime
original_title: EU entrega 10 individuos solicitados por México por varios delitos graves y delincuencia organizada

meta_description: US Ambassador Ronald Johnson said American authorities recently handed over to Mexico 10 fugitives wanted in several states for serious crimes, including kidnapping, drugs, and organized crime.
